name: vscode-supcode-visuals
description: supcode’s text displaying conventions: `kebab-case` identifiers, half-spaced infix operators, and more!

supcodeVisuals.languages.enabled.markdownDescription:
The languages for which supcode visuals are enabled.

If none are provided, supcode visuals are enabled for all languages.

supcodeVisuals.languages.ignored.markdownDescription:
The languages for which supcode visuals are disabled.

Applies after `#supcodeVisuals.languages.enabled#`.

supcodeVisuals.features.kebab-Casify.markdownDescription:
Convert identifiers to `kebab-case`.

For instance, `an_identifier` renders as `an-identifier`. Leading and trailing underscores are left untouched, so `_private_field` remains `_private-field`.

supcodeVisuals.features.dualShift.markdownDescription:
Convert spaces around operators to half-width spaces.

This means single-character infix operators like `=`, `+`, `*`.

supcodeVisuals.features.unspace.markdownDescription:
Strip spaces between function calls and parentheses (intended for legacy codebases with strange formatting).

This displays `func_call ()` as `func_call()`.
